about: Asking Social Security to take less from each payment to repay an overpayment.

rows.plain: If you cannot meet your ordinary and necessary living expenses because of the withholding, you can ask for a lower rate.
Social Security first tries to agree on an amount that repays the whole debt within 12 months.

If the amount you ask for would repay the debt within 60 months, Social Security does not need form SSA-634. If it would take longer, you fill in form SSA-634 with your income, expenses and resources.
For a rate that takes longer than 60 months, Social Security looks at whether your resources are below $3,000 and whether your income is more than your expenses.
If you get full Extra Help with Medicare drug costs, Social Security grants any request of at least $10 a month without form SSA-634.
A lower rate is not approved if the overpayment involved fraud or similar fault.
For SSI, you can ask for a different rate at any time.
Form SSA-634, Request for Change in Overpayment Recovery Rate.
